summary: Component spec (22 tests) and store preview cases were rewritten to the multiblock DTO contract. All TDD-anchor scenarios from the task are present; every test asserts real DOM/state behavior (element existence, DOM order via indexOf, attribute values, literal text), not just mock-was-called. Mocking is minimal (component: store.preview + useRoute = 2; store: useApi = 1) — correct test type. No redundant or empty-assertion tests.
pyramid: Unit/component (vitest + @nuxt/test-utils mountSuspended) — correct for a Vue UI panel; preview-step page wiring is covered separately by Task 10.
tdd_anchors_covered: ordered stack of mixed block types (DOM order via indexOf + data-block-type)
calls store preview with { stepType: MESSAGE, blocks } exactly once on immediate run
reactive block change re-triggers debounced preview (fake timers; 2nd call carries mutated blocks)
text/caption rendered as TEXT never v-html (literal payload + 0 injected elements + static source guard)
binds media via :src for IMAGE (+ referrerpolicy, caption order)
FILE href only for http(s); file_id/non-http -> icon, no href
ALBUM grid of items; caption only on first
buttons under the last block (DOM order)
placeholder for non-message step, no backend call
store: preview sends blocks request + returns renderedBlocks; re-throw on failure

findings.finding: Static no-v-html source guard reads the SFC via readFileSync (cwd=frontend/) and strips comments before matching v-html=/.innerHTML= — robust against comment false-positives (the file mentions v-html in comments deliberately).

Added tests beyond the anchors (VIDEO/AUDIO icon, per-block @error fallback, renderedBlocks-shorter-than-blocks desync safety, IMAGE file_id/non-http src guard, loading state). Each catches a distinct failure mode (no redundancy).

Reactive-change test uses vi.useFakeTimers to deterministically separate the immediate run from the 600ms debounced re-run and asserts the exact mutated blocks payload on the 2nd call — verifies the watch was moved from flat fields to a deep watch on step.blocks.
